name: CuisineAddict
description: French online shop for kitchen utensils, baking equipment, cookware, knives, tableware, small appliances and pantry goods, operating since 2009. Its delivery page lists courier and relay options in France; Corsica and overseas territories are not mentioned.
description_es: Tienda online francesa de utensilios de cocina, repostería, batería de cocina, cuchillos, vajilla, pequeños electrodomésticos y despensa, activa desde 2009. Su página de entregas indica opciones de mensajería y puntos relais en Francia; no menciona Córcega ni los territorios de ultramar.

ships_to.notes: Delivery page lists DPD delivery to metropolitan France and relay points in France; Corsica and DOM-TOM not mentioned.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Relay-point and post-office collection is offered with carriers; no physical store pickup is mentioned.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Delivery page also lists Mondial Relay to Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Spain and Germany, and Colissimo within the EU. A separate Spanish site exists at cuisineaddict.es.

sources.supports: carrier delivery areas and relay points
